scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && uv sync && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.makemigration: cd backend && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
